title: The Easy Trail
idea: Jonny's friend comedies 24 (30 Oct 2026): 'my friend said this trail was easy': a first-person ride behind Reaper ends off a cliff; Dragon catches the Wizard, and Reaper never needed the ground

hook.what: a first-person ride racing down a forest trail behind Reaper on a tiny bike

captions.text: my friend said this trail was easy

do.reason: riding fast: the wind past the rider's ears (first-person)
both bikes' tyres buzzing on the dirt trail
Reaper's bike lands after his hop over the root
tyres back on the dirt after the hop
the bike slams down after the big hop over the root
the wheels rattle over the plank
Phoenix sweeps past beside the rider (a passing wing whoosh)
tyres on the dirt again up to the edge
the wind rising as the trail ends at the cliff
Dragon catches the Wizard on his back: a soft flump
Reaper's bicycle chain ticking as he pedals calmly in mid-air

allowClip.reason: the Wizard sits on his bike, gloves round its grips
Reaper sits on his tiny bike, gloves round its grips
the Wizard sits astride Dragon's back, his gloves on Dragon's crown
